policy: inactive integer kernel (COMMON-AD 87.1; P8 rules.rs class inactive): every argument integer; result derivative words zero both ways, jp/laytrop/spec untouched

args.name: jp
args.inactive_reason: Integer pressure-table index (rsw_setcoef_b: (int)(36 - 5(ln p + 0.04)) clamped to [1,58]); frozen at the trajectory's.

args.name: laytrop
args.inactive_reason: Integer tropospheric layer count (host sum of setcoef's trop flags); frozen at the trajectory's.

args.name: spec
args.inactive_reason: Host table constants (layreffr, upper-loop flag, has-layreffr flag) per SW band 16..29.

args.name: result
args.inactive_reason: Integer Fortran layer index of each band's solar source (read by rsw_sfluxzen_b). Piecewise constant in the state through jp: frozen at the trajectory's value (the forward writes it); derivative words zero.

saved.name: result
saved.what: the trajectory's laysolfr, written by the forward itself and read by rsw_sfluxzen_b; never recomputed from a perturbed state

branches.predicate: row[prev] < lr && row[lay-1] >= lr (upper scan, last wins)
branches.rule: integer comparison of jp against layreffr: index selection, zero derivative; the index is the trajectory's

branches.predicate: row[lay-1] < lr && row[next] >= lr (lower scan, last wins)
branches.rule: integer comparison of jp against layreffr: index selection, zero derivative; the index is the trajectory's
integer clamp of the selected layer to the tropopause: index selection, nothing to freeze

branches.inactive_reason: Gather-index clamp; binds only at lay == nlayers (laytrop == nlayers).

refusal.domain: nlayers >= 1 (forward % nlayers), 0 <= laytrop[col] <= nlayers (forward jp reads stay inside the column), ncol*14 <= INT_MAX (forward int thread index)

precondition: jp, laytrop, spec and result (and their derivative mirrors) do not alias; one thread per (column, band) touches only its own result word.
precision: no float arithmetic at all (forward or derivative). Built -O3 --fmad=false --ftz=false (live-scheme flags) for uniformity.
piecewise_affine_arms: Constant (zero) map on result for every executed index selection; there is no float input, so no tie set in this kernel's own inputs (the ties live upstream, in setcoef's jp truncation of ln p).
